item.title: Oxford Parks Master Plan Survey
item.description:
The City of Oxford is developing a Parks Master Plan and wants feedback from Talawanda families who use the parks. The city is working with Pros Consulting on this initiative.

item.title: Community Bingo for Older Americans Month
item.description:
Older Americans Month (May 2026) celebrates older adults with the theme "Champion Your Health." Oxford Seniors, Age-Friendly Oxford, and Coalition for a Healthy Community are hosting Community BINGO throughout May. Pick up a BINGO card at Oxford Seniors (922 Tollgate Dr.), Oxford Lane Library (441 S. Locust St.), The Knolls of Oxford, or Scripps Gerontology Center (396 Upham Hall). Mark off activities as you complete them (goal: get 5 in a row). Bring completed cards to the Intergenerational BINGO Party on May 31, 3:00-5:00 PM at Oxford Seniors for prizes and snacks.

item.title: Oxford Swim and Dive Team Registration
item.description:
The Oxford Swim and Dive Team is a community summer competitive program for ages 4-18 of all abilities. Practices begin May 26, 2026 at the Oxford Aquatic Center with various schedules for different age groups. Registration costs: Swim Team $150, Dive $120, Swim & Dive $200 (discounts available for multiple children; pool membership required). A trial period is available May 26-29 for $30. Additionally, Coach Steve offers a Makos Stroke Clinic at Miami's Rec Center for swimmers ages 5-13, April 20 - May 22, 2026, and Dive Well practice on Mondays, Wednesdays & Fridays 5:30-6:30 pm (Spring Session $180). Register at swimosdt.com or contact oxfordswimdive@gmail.com.

item.title: Respect for Law Camp Registration Open
item.description:
Respect for Law Camp is a 3-day program for kids ages 11-14, taking place June 19-21, 2026 at Miami University Oxford. The action-packed weekend includes hands-on law enforcement activities like rappelling from a fire tower, SWAT and building search exercises, FBI Pellet Gun Course, mock felony car crash, motorcycle/bicycle/aviation demonstrations, Firearms Training Simulator (FATS), high and low ropes courses, and bomb squad and K-9 demonstrations. Register by scanning the QR code or visiting respectforlawcamp.org.

item.title: Join the PTG - Meeting March 23rd
item.description:
The PTG is welcoming new board members for the 2026-2027 school year. A meeting is scheduled for March 23rd at 2:30 PM in the TMS Media Center to plan goals and vision for the upcoming school year. The board currently has positions filled for President (Sarah Meaney), Vice President (Stephene Seals-Spahn), and Treasurer (Jenna Fillmore), with an open Secretary position. Parents, students, teachers, and staff are all welcome to attend and help brainstorm ways to support students and staff. Email tmsptgbrave@gmail.com if interested in the Secretary position.

item.title: World Teen Mental Health Day Celebration
item.description:
Talawanda Middle School celebrated World Teen Mental Health Day on Monday, March 2nd with activities organized by the Brave Initiative Team and Sources of Strength Team. Thanks to funding from bi3, Interact for Health, and the Joe Burrow Foundation, each student received a mental health toolkit with items promoting strategies like journaling and physical activity. Students also created a display honoring mentors in their lives during lunch. For more information, contact Talawanda Health & Wellness at 513.273.3390 or view the VIDEO of the day's events.

item.title: Caregiver Group for Parents of Children with ADHD
item.description:
Miami University Psychology Clinic is offering an 8-week caregiver support group focused on understanding and managing ADHD in children ages 6-12. The group meets Wednesdays 5:30-7:00pm in-person, starting in March. To participate, caregivers must have a child diagnosed with ADHD, complete a 1-hour pre-group intake session, and commit to 8 weeks of attendance. TSI-APPROVED for distribution with TSD. Contact: 513-529-2423 or psychologyclinic@miamioh.edu
